Q6064.reason: The lease bound the successor until 1992, so only 17 years had run by 2009, short of the 20-year period, and a tenant who believed the lease still ran lacks hostile intent; the note's claim that nonpayment ends the lease at once is wrong, since a landlord's death doesn't terminate a lease.

Q8442.reason: Austin (1832) drew the general versus particular jurisprudence distinction, which predates Holland's Elements of Jurisprudence (1880), so the note's attribution to Holland doesn't hold.
